in_marathi.name: Narayanlal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narayanlal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lord Narayan is a deity in Hinduism, often considered the supreme god, and is the preserver of the universe according to the Dharma. The name Narayan is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Nara' meaning man and 'Ayan' meaning protector. Hence, Narayan means the protector of mankind.

The name Narayan is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Nara' meaning man and 'Ayan' meaning protector. Hence, Narayan means the protector of mankind.
